posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
if you need an offset to the side, that means that either the sprite is not correctly centered or of the wrong cell size. Only the y-coordinate (height) is partially modified by the engine.
So you basically need to redo the sprite in an image program with the correct cell size and correctly centered.
For more help on what exactly your problem is we need to see the full sprite (all twelve cells) instead of the single cell you originally attached.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
that means you need a cell larger than 96x144, and the existing image needs to be place carefully inside that larger cell in a way that it is correctly centered inside the cell. Which in this case is NOT in the middle of the cell, it needs to be graphically centered not mathematically
assuming that your offset of 12 is correct and not only a vague guess, the cell size would have to be something like 108x168 for easiest placement - it might be possible to make it with a smaller cell, but that requires either experience on sprite creation or careful editing after placement.
and a transparent frame around a larger sprite should be no problem in this case, so that's where I would start.
